from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

num_qubits = 4
num_clbits = 4

qc = QuantumCircuit(num_qubits, num_clbits)

# Step 1: Apply H gate to all qubits
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
qc.h(2)
qc.h(3)

# Step 2: Apply Rz gates
qc.rz(2.8507, 0)
qc.rz(0.2836, 1)
qc.rz(2.7925, 2)
qc.rz(2.7328, 3)

# Step 3: Apply CNOT(0,1), Rz(1.6627, 1), CNOT(0,1)
qc.cx(0, 1)
qc.rz(1.6627, 1)
qc.cx(0, 1)

# Step 4: Apply CNOT(1,2), Rz(1.9952, 2), CNOT(1,2)
qc.cx(1, 2)
qc.rz(1.9952, 2)
qc.cx(1, 2)

# Step 5: Apply CNOT(2,3), Rz(0.2854, 3), CNOT(2,3)
qc.cx(2, 3)
qc.rz(0.2854, 3)
qc.cx(2, 3)

# Step 6: Repeat Steps 1-5
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
qc.h(2)
qc.h(3)

qc.rz(2.8507, 0)
qc.rz(0.2836, 1)
qc.rz(2.7925, 2)
qc.rz(2.7328, 3)

qc.cx(0, 1)
qc.rz(1.6627, 1)
qc.cx(0, 1)

qc.cx(1, 2)
qc.rz(1.9952, 2)
qc.cx(1, 2)

qc.cx(2, 3)
qc.rz(0.2854, 3)
qc.cx(2, 3)

# Step 7: Measure qubits
qc.measure([0, 1, 2, 3], [0, 1, 2, 3])
